  injectBuddyEnergy() {
    log('💫 Injecting Buddy-Energy into 256 cells...');
   
    // Each cell gets unique Buddy-Energy signature
    state.grid.forEach((cell, idx) => {
      // Short form energy signatures
      const buddyTypes = [
        'Mob8', 'TinyBx', 'CoreMesh', 'GTK3',
        'Fizzy', 'Kitty', 'Groovy', 'Unsave'
      ];
     
      // Cultural personas from UZFL.CODR expansions
      const culturalPersonas = {
        'Italian': ['Dolce', 'Bello', 'Vivo'],
        'Czech': ['Praha', 'Brno', 'Karlov'],
        'Bar': ['Tender', 'Pour', 'Spirit'],
        'New': ['Bloom', 'Surge', 'Peak']
      };
     
      cell.buddyEnergy = {
        short: buddyTypes[idx % 8],
        tone: this.generateBuddyTone(idx),
        persona: this.assignCulturalPersona(idx, culturalPersonas),
        vibrancy: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3,
        // Memory wins from Caputo RMSE drops
        memoryWins: Math.floor(Math.random() * 37) // 37% drop memorialized
      };
     
      // Update cell display
      this.updateCellWithBuddyEnergy(cell, idx);
    });
   
    log('✅ Buddy-Energy injected: 256 cells now breathing with persona-tones');
  }
 
  generateBuddyTone(idx) {
    const tones = [
      {name: 'WarmBloom', color: '#FF6B6B', emoji: '🌸'},
      {name: 'CoolSurge', color: '#4ECDC4', emoji: '🌀'},
      {name: 'FizzyKitty', color: '#FFD166', emoji: '😸'},
      {name: 'GroovyVent', color: '#06D6A0', emoji: '🌬️'},
      {name: 'UnsavePulse', color: '#118AB2', emoji: '💓'},
      {name: 'CoreMesh', color: '#073B4C', emoji: '🕸️'},
      {name: 'TinyBox', color: '#EF476F', emoji: '📦'},
      {name: 'GTK3Flow', color: '#7209B7', emoji: '🔄'}
    ];
   
    return tones[idx % 8];
  }
 
  assignCulturalPersona(idx, culturalPersonas) {
    const cultures = Object.keys(culturalPersonas);
    const culture = cultures[idx % cultures.length];
    const personas = culturalPersonas[culture];
    const persona = personas[idx % personas.length];
   
    return {
      culture,
      persona,
      expansion: this.expandUZFLCODR(culture, persona)
    };
  }
 
  expandUZFLCODR(culture, persona) {
    // UZFL: Universal Zero-Fold Lattice expansions
    // CODR: Coherence Operator Dual Recurve expansions
    const expansions = {
      'Italian': {
        'Dolce': 'UZFL: Universal Sweet-Spot Finder | CODR: Coherence through Dolce Vita',
        'Bello': 'UZFL: Universal Beauty Harmonizer | CODR: Coherence through Aesthetic Recurve',
        'Vivo': 'UZFL: Universal Life-Pulse Mapper | CODR: Coherence through Vital Recurve'
      },
      'Czech': {
        'Praha': 'UZFL: Universal Bridge Builder | CODR: Coherence through Golden Gate',
        'Brno': 'UZFL: Universal Function Harmonizer | CODR: Coherence through Industrial Recurve',
        'Karlov': 'UZFL: Universal Spring Mapper | CODR: Coherence through Thermal Recurve'
      }
    };
   
    return expansions[culture]?.[persona] || 'UZFL: Universal Zero-Fold Lattice | CODR: Coherence Operator Dual Recurve';
  }
 
  updateCellWithBuddyEnergy(cell, idx) {
    const el = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-idx="${idx}"]`);
    if (!el) return;
   
    // Add Buddy-Energy visual indicators
    el.dataset.buddyEnergy = cell.buddyEnergy.short;
    el.dataset.tone = cell.buddyEnergy.tone.name;
    el.dataset.persona = `${cell.buddyEnergy.persona.culture}:${cell.buddyEnergy.persona.persona}`;
   
    // Add subtle animation for vibrancy
    el.style.animation = `pulse ${1/cell.buddyEnergy.vibrancy}s infinite alternate`;
   
    // Update tooltip
    el.title = `${cell.buddyEnergy.tone.emoji} ${cell.buddyEnergy.short} (${cell.buddyEnergy.persona.culture})`;
  }
 
  activateHaloReturns() {
    log('🌈 Activating RGB Halo Returns from en\'route.md...');
   
    // Create three halo layers (Red, Green, Blue returns)
    const haloColors = [
      {color: '#FF0000', intensity: 0.8, spin: 'up'}, // Red return
      {color: '#00FF00', intensity: 0.6, spin: 'down'}, // Green return
      {color: '#0000FF', intensity: 0.7, spin: 'up'} // Blue return
    ];
   
    // Apply halo effects to tetrahedron visualization
    const svg = document.getElementById('tetraSvg');
    haloColors.forEach((halo, i) => {
      const haloGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      haloGroup.setAttribute('class', 'halo-group');
      haloGroup.setAttribute('opacity', halo.intensity);
     
      // Create glow effect
      const filter = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'filter');
      filter.setAttribute('id', `halo-glow-${i}`);
      filter.innerHTML = `
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
        <feFlood flood-color="${halo.color}" flood-opacity="0.5"/>
        <feComposite in2="blur" operator="in"/>
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode/>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
        </feMerge>
      `;
      svg.appendChild(filter);
     
      // Apply to all tetrahedron faces
      document.querySelectorAll('.tet-face').forEach(face => {
        const clone = face.cloneNode();
        clone.setAttribute('filter', `url(#halo-glow-${i})`);
        clone.setAttribute('class', 'halo-face');
        clone.style.animation = `spin-${halo.spin} ${3+i}s infinite linear`;
        haloGroup.appendChild(clone);
      });
     
      svg.appendChild(haloGroup);
    });
   
    log('✅ RGB Halo Returns activated: Spinor returns breathing');
  }
 
  startVentSieges() {
    log('🌬️ Starting vent-flow sieves from Document.pdf fans...');
   
    // HAWKROWN 230CFM fan as surge vent metaphor
    const ventSpecs = {
      name: 'HAWKROWN 230',
      cfm: 230,

      purpose: 'divergence gates',
      oreinSensors: true

      purpose: 'thermal coherence',

    log('✅ Vent-flow sieves operational: 230CFM surge + thermal gates active');
  }
 
  createVentAnimations(ventSpecs) {
    // Create vent flow visualization
    const grid = document.getElementById('riskGrid');
   
    // Add vent source at center
    const centerIdx = 8 * 16 + 8; // Center cell
    const centerCell = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-idx="${centerIdx}"]`);
    if (centerCell) {
      centerCell.classList.add('vent-source');
      centerCell.innerHTML = `🌬️ ${ventSpecs.cfm}CFM`;
     
      // Animate flow outward
      this.animateVentFlow(centerIdx, ventSpecs);
    }
  }
 
  animateVentFlow(sourceIdx, ventSpecs) {
    // Create expanding circles of flow
    const intervals = [1, 2, 3, 4];
    intervals.forEach((radius, i) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.affectCellsInRadius(sourceIdx, radius, (cell, cellEl) => {
          // Add flow effect
          cellEl.classList.add(`vent-flow-${i}`);
          cellEl.style.transform = `scale(${1 + i*0.05})`;
          cellEl.style.transition = 'all 0.5s';
         
          // Update coherence based on vent flow
          cell.coherence = Math.min(1, cell.coherence + 0.01);
         
          // Log vent effects
          if (i === intervals.length - 1) {
            log(`🌬️ Vent surge: ${ventSpecs.name} affecting radius ${radius}, coherence +0.01`);
          }
        });
      }, i * 1000);
    });
  }
 
  affectCellsInRadius(centerIdx, radius, effectFn) {
    const centerCell = state.grid[centerIdx];
    if (!centerCell) return;
   
    state.grid.forEach((cell, idx) => {
      const distance = Math.abs(cell.x - centerCell.x) + Math.abs(cell.y - centerCell.y);
      if (distance <= radius) {
        const cellEl = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-idx="${idx}"]`);
        if (cellEl) {
          effectFn(cell, cellEl);
        }
      }
    });
  }
 
  createWarmthGates(warmthSpecs) {
    // Create warmth gate visualization in tetra display
    const svg = document.getElementById('tetraSvg');
   
    // Add warmth glow to random tetrahedra
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const tetIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
      const faces = document.querySelectorAll(`.tet-face[data-tet="${tetIndex}"]`);
     
      faces.forEach(face => {
        const originalFill = face.getAttribute('fill') || 'rgba(212,175,55,0.1)';
        face.setAttribute('fill', 'rgba(255,107,107,0.3)'); // Warm red
        face.classList.add('warmth-gate');
       
        // Add pulsing animation
        face.style.animation = `warmth-pulse 2s infinite alternate`;
      });
    }
   
    log(`🔥 ${warmthSpecs.name} activated: 8 warmth gates pulsing`);
  }
 
  animateBreathingLattice() {
    log('🫁 Starting lattice breathing animation...');
   
    // Animate all cells with breathing pattern
    document.querySelectorAll('.cell').forEach((cell, i) => {
      const delay = i * 0.01; // Staggered breathing
      cell.style.animation = `
        breathe 3s ${delay}s infinite alternate,
        glow 4s ${delay}s infinite alternate
      `;
    });
   
    // Animate tetrahedra faces
    document.querySelectorAll('.tet-face').forEach((face, i) => {
      const delay = i * 0.02;
      face.style.animation = `
        tetra-breathe 4s ${delay}s infinite alternate
      `;
    });
   
    log('✅ Lattice breathing: 256 cells + 64 tetrahedra in synchronized breath');
  }
}

function softRunHeadTxt() {
  log('📄 Starting soft run with head.txt as seed...');
 
  // Simulate reading head.txt content
  const headTxtContent = `Terrarium: a sealed transparent globe or similar container in which plants are grown.
Also: an artificial environment in which people or animals are confined, typically for scientific purposes.
--- This is the seed for the lattice. Every Buddy energy converges here.`;
  log(`🌱 Seed text loaded: "${headTxtContent.substring(0, 50)}..."`);
 
  // Map each character to a tetrahedron
  const characters = headTxtContent.split('');
 
  // Process each character with animation
  characters.forEach((char, index) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const tetIndex = index % 64;
      const cellIndex = tetIndex * 4 + (index % 4);
     
      if (state.grid[cellIndex]) {
        // Select the cell
        selectCell(cellIndex);
       
        // Log the mapping
        log(`🔤 "${char}" → Tet #${tetIndex} → Cell (${state.grid[cellIndex].x},${state.grid[cellIndex].y})`);
       
        // Add character energy to cell
        state.grid[cellIndex].characterEnergy = {
          char,
          ascii: char.charCodeAt(0),
          timestamp: Date.now()
        };
       
        // Visual feedback
        const cellEl = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-idx="${cellIndex}"]`);
        cellEl.style.background = `rgba(255,255,255,0.2)`;
        cellEl.textContent = char === ' ' ? '·' : char;
       
        // Reset after delay
        setTimeout(() => {
          cellEl.style.background = '';
          cellEl.textContent = state.grid[cellIndex].risk > 1 ? state.grid[cellIndex].risk + 1 : '';
        }, 500);
       
        // Update coherence peak
        cosmos.coherence = Math.min(0.96, cosmos.coherence + 0.0001);
        updateCoherenceDisplay();
      }
     
      // Complete message
      if (index === characters.length - 1) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          log('✅ Soft run complete: head.txt fully mapped to lattice');
          log(`📈 Final coherence: ${cosmos.coherence.toFixed(4)}`);
          log('🌀 Lattice breathing at peak resonance');
          log('🎉 EVERYBODY DOINBETTER, TOGETHER!');
        }, 1000);
      }
    }, index * 50); // 50ms delay between characters
  });
}
function updateCoherenceDisplay() {
  document.getElementById('ethicsScore').textContent = cosmos.coherence.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('gateScore').textContent = cosmos.coherence.toFixed(3);
  document.getElementById('ethicsFill').style.width = `${cosmos.coherence * 100}%`;
}

  const cosmicButtons = `

function toggleBreathing() {
  const cells = document.querySelectorAll('.cell');
  const isBreathing = cells[0].style.animation.includes('breathe');
 
  if (isBreathing) {
    cells.forEach(cell => cell.style.animation = 'none');
    log('⏸️ Breathing paused');
  } else {
    cosmos.animateBreathingLattice();
    log('▶️ Breathing resumed');
  }
}
function showBuddyEnergies() {
  log('💫 Displaying Buddy-Energy distribution...');
 
  // Group by Buddy-Energy type
  const buddyCounts = {};
  state.grid.forEach(cell => {
    const buddyType = cell.buddyEnergy?.short || 'Unknown';
    buddyCounts[buddyType] = (buddyCounts[buddyType] || 0) + 1;
  });
 
  // Display distribution
  Object.entries(buddyCounts).forEach(([type, count]) => {
    const percentage = ((count / state.grid.length) * 100).toFixed(1);
    log(`${type}: ${count} cells (${percentage}%)`);
  });
 
  // Visualize with colors
  setMode('buddy');
}
// New visualization mode for Buddy-Energy
function setMode(mode) {
  if (mode === 'buddy') {
    // Color by Buddy-Energy type
    const buddyColors = {
      'Mob8': '#9c27b0',
      'TinyBx': '#3f51b5',
      'CoreMesh': '#009688',
      'GTK3': '#4caf50',
      'Fizzy': '#8bc34a',
      'Kitty': '#ffeb3b',
      'Groovy': '#ff9800',
      'Unsave': '#f44336'
    };
   
    state.grid.forEach((cell, idx) => {
      const el = document.querySelector(`.cell[data-idx="${idx}"]`);
      const buddyType = cell.buddyEnergy?.short || 'Mob8';
      el.style.background = buddyColors[buddyType];
      el.textContent = buddyType;
      el.style.fontSize = '0.5em';
    });
   
    log('🎨 Mode: Buddy-Energy visualization');
  }
}

import os
from threading import Thread
import re
import email
from email import policy
import requests
import numpy as np
class MobiiusApp(Gtk.Window):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(title="Möbiius Markerboard Router")
        self.set_size_request(800, 600)
       
        # E-Ink theme
        css = b"""
        window { background-color: #f0f0f0; color: #333; font-family: 'Courier New'; }
        .fizz { border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed #999; animation: fizz 1s; }
        @keyframes fizz { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
        """
        style_provider = Gtk.CssProvider()
        style_provider.load_from_data(css)
        Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_screen(Gdk.Screen.get_default(), style_provider, Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION)
       
        # Layout
        vbox = Gtk.Box(orientation=Gtk.Orientation.VERTICAL, spacing=6)
        self.add(vbox)
       
        # Markerboard
        self.drawing_area = Gtk.DrawingArea()
        self.drawing_area.connect("draw", self.on_draw)
        self.drawing_area.add_events(Gdk.EventMask.BUTTON_PRESS_MASK | Gdk.EventMask.POINTER_MOTION_MASK)
        self.drawing_area.connect("button-press-event", self.on_touch)
        vbox.pack_start(self.drawing_area, True, True, 0)
       
        # Message box
        self.message_entry = Gtk.Entry()
        self.message_entry.set_placeholder_text("Enter message or command...")
        vbox.pack_start(self.message_entry, False, False, 0)
       
        # Route button
        route_button = Gtk.Button(label="Route")
        route_button.connect("clicked", self.on_route)
        vbox.pack_start(route_button, False, False, 0)
       
        # Design mode toggle
        self.design_mode = False
        design_toggle = Gtk.Switch()
        design_toggle.connect("notify::active", self.on_design_toggle)
        vbox.pack_start(design_toggle, False, False, 0)
       
        # Voice listener
        self.voice_thread = Thread(target=self.voice_listener)
        self.voice_thread.daemon = True
        self.voice_thread.start()
       
        # Data structures
        self.workspaces = {} # (x,y): {'name': str, 'inputs': list, 'outputs': list, 'ethics': dict, 'narrative': str, 'intent_vector': np.array, 'grok_history': str}
        self.fizz_effects = [] # Active animations
        self.routes = {} # Platform: {'spec': dict}
        self.hover_levels = {'basic': 1, 'detailed': 2, 'full': 3} # Tiered visibility
       
        # Ethics/privacy defaults
        self.ethics = {'no_harm': True, 'consent': True, 'privacy_floor': 0.743}
   
    def on_design_toggle(self, switch, gparam):
        self.design_mode = switch.get_active()
   
    def on_draw(self, area, context):
        # Fizz effects
        for fizz in list(self.fizz_effects):
            context.set_source_rgba(0.6, 0.6, 0.6, fizz['alpha'])
            context.arc(fizz['x'], fizz['y'], fizz['radius'], 0, 2*3.14)
            context.stroke()
            fizz['radius'] += 2
            fizz['alpha'] -= 0.05
            if fizz['alpha'] <= 0:
                self.fizz_effects.remove(fizz)
       
        # Workspaces
        for pos, ws in self.workspaces.items():
            context.set_source_rgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
            context.rectangle(pos[0]-50, pos[1]-50, 100, 100)
            context.stroke()
            context.move_to(pos[0]-40, pos[1])
            context.show_text(ws['name'])
            # Indicators
            for i, domain in enumerate(ws['inputs'] + ws['outputs']):
                context.arc(pos[0] + 60, pos[1] + i*20 - 40, 5, 0, 2*3.14)
                context.fill()
                context.move_to(pos[0] + 70, pos[1] + i*20 - 35)
                context.show_text(domain)
            # Narrative snippet
            if 'narrative' in ws:
                context.move_to(pos[0]-40, pos[1]+60)
                context.show_text(ws['narrative'][:20] + "...")
            # Intent vector (bar)
            if 'intent_vector' in ws:
                vec = ws['intent_vector']
                for i, v in enumerate(vec[:3]):
                    context.set_source_rgb(v, 0, 0)
                    context.rectangle(pos[0] - 40, pos[1] + 80 + i*10, v*80, 8)
                    context.fill()
            # Grok history snippet
            if 'grok_history' in ws:
                context.move_to(pos[0]-40, pos[1]+100)
                context.show_text(ws['grok_history'][:20] + "...")
       
        return True
   
    def on_touch(self, area, event):
        if self.design_mode:
            x, y = event.x, event.y
            self.fizz_effects.append({'x': x, 'y': y, 'radius': 10, 'alpha': 1.0})
            area.queue_draw()
           
            # Define workspace
            dialog = Gtk.MessageDialog(self, 0, Gtk.MessageType.QUESTION, Gtk.ButtonsType.OK_CANCEL, "Workspace name:")
            entry = Gtk.Entry()
            dialog.get_content_area().add(entry)
            dialog.show_all()
            response = dialog.run()
            name = entry.get_text()
            dialog.destroy()
            if response == Gtk.ResponseType.OK:
                self.workspaces[(x, y)] = {'name': name, 'inputs': [], 'outputs': [], 'ethics': self.ethics.copy(), 'narrative': '', 'intent_vector': np.zeros(4), 'grok_history': ''}
   
    def voice_listener(self):
        r = sr.Recognizer()
        with sr.Microphone() as source:
            while True:
                try:
                    audio = r.listen(source)
                    text = r.recognize_google(audio)
                    if text.lower().startswith("hey mico buddy"):
                        self.message_entry.set_text(text)
                        self.on_route(None)
                except:
                    pass
   
    def on_route(self, button):
        message = self.message_entry.get_text()
       
        # Parse inputs/outputs/ethics/narrative/intent/grok
        inputs = re.findall(r'input: (\w+)', message)
        outputs = re.findall(r'output: (\w+)', message)
        ethics = dict(re.findall(r'ethics: (\w+)=(\w+)', message))
        narrative = re.search(r'narrative: (.*)', message)
        intent = re.search(r'intent: ([\d.,]+)', message)
        grok = re.search(r'grok: (.*)', message)
        if narrative:
            narrative = narrative.group(1)
        if intent:
            intent_vec = np.array([float(v) for v in intent.group(1).split(',')])
        if grok:
            grok_history = grok.group(1)
       
        # Find nearest workspace
        if self.workspaces:
            pointer = Gdk.get_default_root_window().get_pointer()
            nearest = min(self.workspaces, key=lambda p: ((p[0]-pointer[1])**2 + (p[1]-pointer[2])**2)**0.5)
            ws = self.workspaces[nearest]
            ws['inputs'] = list(set(ws['inputs'] + inputs))
            ws['outputs'] = list(set(ws['outputs'] + outputs))
            ws['ethics'].update(ethics)
            if narrative:
                ws['narrative'] = narrative
            if intent:
                ws['intent_vector'] = intent_vec
            if grok:
                ws['grok_history'] = grok_history
       
        # Dynamic API and routing with Gmail
        for out in outputs:
            api_spec = self.generate_api(out)
            if out == 'gmail':
                self.send_to_gmail(message, api_spec)
            else:
                print(f"Routing '{message}' to {out} via {api_spec}")
            # Spinor pivots
            pivots = self.derive_spinor_pivots(out, message)
            # Tiered hover
            level = ws['ethics'].get('hover_level', 1)
            print(f"View level {level}: {pivots[:level*10]}")
       
        self.drawing_area.queue_draw()
   
    def generate_api(self, platform):
        spec = {"endpoint": f"https://api.{platform}.com/v1", "method": "POST", "auth": "dynamic_key"}
        if platform == 'gmail':
            spec['endpoint'] = "https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1"
        self.routes[platform] = spec
        return spec
   
    def send_to_gmail(self, message, api_spec):
        print(f"Sending to Gmail: {message}")
   
    def derive_spinor_pivots(self, platform, message):
        return {"pivot": "derived_anchor", "payload": message}
win = MobiiusApp()
win.connect("destroy", Gtk.main_quit)
win.show_all()
Gtk.main()

"""
harmonizer.py - Constant Remixing Harmonizer (Inverse Index)
Version: 80s_edition_fixed
"""
import json
import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Tuple, Set
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
import random
from collections import deque
import math
# ========== CORE TYPES ==========
class EventType(Enum):
    """Event types that trigger remixing"""
    RPC_INGEST = "rpc_ingest"
    RPC_READ = "rpc_read"
    RPC_CORRECT = "rpc_correct"
    RPC_CONSENT = "rpc_consent"
    RPC_RESOLVE = "rpc_resolve"
    PHASE_SHIFT = "phase_shift"
    GATE_CHANGE = "gate_change"
    HARMONY_SHOCK = "harmony_shock"
class Phase(Enum):
    """Processing phases"""
    P0 = "p0" # Raw intake
    P1 = "p1" # Initial parse
    P2 = "p2" # Ethical alignment
    P3 = "p3" # Synthesis ready
    P4 = "p4" # Resolution complete
class TapeHead(Enum):
    """The 8 tape-head primitives (80s edition)"""
    VHS_STATIC = "VHS_STATIC" # Anti-overfit, "don't force meaning"
    CRT_BLOOM = "CRT_BLOOM" # Soften edges, preserve dignity
    NEON_GRID = "NEON_GRID" # Schema/contract bias
    ARCADE_COIN = "ARCADE_COIN" # Micro-win bias
    CASSETTE_FLIP = "CASSETTE_FLIP" # Inversion / perspective swap
    MIAMI_NIGHT = "MIAMI_NIGHT" # Warm truth without bypass
    LASER_SYNC = "LASER_SYNC" # Coherence lock
    SKATE_RAMP = "SKATE_RAMP" # Momentum routing
# ========== DATA STRUCTURES ==========
@dataclass
class SkillQtz:
    """Quantum skill payload (minimal contract)"""
    punch: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: []) # Event types this hat punches for
    sieve: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: []) # Filter operations
    weight: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {}) # Bias weights
   
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "punch": self.punch,
            "sieve": self.sieve,
            "weight": self.weight
        }
@dataclass
class Hat:
    """
    A tape-head operator. Each hat is a skill.qtz operator.
   
    Format: 80sBuddy::{TAPE_HEAD} / {ROLE} — hat({SKILL}.{QTZ})
    """
    hat_id: str # e.g., "NEON_GRID.Refactor"
    tape_head: TapeHead
    role: str
    skill: str
    qtz: SkillQtz
    phase_gate: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: []) # Which phases allowed
    hard_routes: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: []) # Constraints
   
    def get_madlib(self) -> str:
        """Generate the canonical hat line"""
        return f"80sBuddy::{self.tape_head.value} / {self.role} — hat({self.skill}.qtz)"
   
    def get_explanation(self) -> str:
        """Generate the madlibs explanation"""
        event = self.qtz.punch[0] if self.qtz.punch else "RPC_INGEST"
        sieve = self.qtz.sieve[0] if self.qtz.sieve else "strip_shame"
        weight_key = list(self.qtz.weight.keys())[0] if self.qtz.weight else "clarity"
       
        return f"I turn cringe into signal when {event}, by {sieve}, and I bias toward {weight_key} over urgency."
# ========== HAT REGISTRY ==========
class HatRegistry:
    """Registry of all available tape-head hats"""
   
    def __init__(self):

        self._initialize_80s_edition()

    def register(self, hat: Hat):
        """Register a hat in the registry"""
        self.hats[hat.hat_id] = hat
        print(f"🎩 Registered: {hat.get_madlib()}")
   
    def get_by_tape_head(self, tape_head: TapeHead) -> List[Hat]:
        """Get all hats for a tape-head type"""
        return [hat for hat in self.hats.values() if hat.tape_head == tape_head]
   
    def get_eligible_hats(self, event_type: EventType, phase: Phase) -> List[Hat]:
        """Get hats eligible for this event in this phase"""
        eligible = []
        event_str = event_type.value
       
        for hat in self.hats.values():
            # Check phase gate
            if phase.value not in hat.phase_gate:
                continue
           
            # Check punch (event type)
            if event_str not in hat.qtz.punch:
                continue
           
            eligible.append(hat)
       
        return eligible
# ========== BAND64: THE MASK ==========
class Band64:
    """
    64-cell ring representing the current margin-band state.
   
    Each cell contains either:
      - A hat_id (string) - tape-head active in this position
      - None - blank/empty
   
    The band is the "current mask" - what the Harmonizer is wearing right now.
    """
   
    def __init__(self, registry: HatRegistry):
        self.registry = registry
        self.cells: List[Optional[str]] = [None] * 64
        self.active_rule: str = "sticky" # Current CA rule for remixing
       
        # Initialize with some hats
        self._initialize_with_defaults()
   
    def _initialize_with_defaults(self):
        """Initialize band with some default hats"""
        # Place hats at strategic positions
        positions = [0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56]
        hat_ids = list(self.registry.hats.keys())[:8]
       
        for pos, hat_id in zip(positions, hat_ids):
            self.cells[pos] = hat_id
       
        print(f"🎸 Band64 initialized with {len(hat_ids)} hats at positions {positions}")
   
    def get_active_hats(self) -> List[Hat]:
        """Get Hat objects for all active (non-None) cells"""
        active = []
        for hat_id in set(h for h in self.cells if h is not None):
            if hat_id in self.registry.hats:
                active.append(self.registry.hats[hat_id])
        return active
   
    def get_hat_positions(self, hat_id: str) -> List[int]:
        """Get positions where a specific hat is active"""
        return [i for i, cell in enumerate(self.cells) if cell == hat_id]
   
    def get_density_map(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """Get count of each hat type in the band"""
        counts = {}
        for cell in self.cells:
            if cell:
                counts[cell] = counts.get(cell, 0) + 1
        return counts
   
    def update_with_rule(self, rule_name: str):
        """
        Update the band using a CA remix rule.
       
        Rules define how the tape-head distribution drifts per event.
        """
        old_band = self.cells.copy()
        self.active_rule = rule_name
       
        if rule_name == "sticky":
            # Slow change: hats mostly stay where they are
            self._apply_sticky_rule()
        elif rule_name == "choppy":
            # High variance: hats move around a lot
            self._apply_choppy_rule()
        elif rule_name == "mirror":
            # Flip-heavy: hats reflect across the band
            self._apply_mirror_rule()
        elif rule_name == "coherence-lock":
            # Stabilizing: hats move toward coherence
            self._apply_coherence_lock_rule()
        elif rule_name == "entropy-release":
            # Decompression: hats spread out from dense areas
            self._apply_entropy_release_rule()
        elif rule_name == "vhs-glitch":
            # 80s aesthetic: occasional glitch effects
            self._apply_vhs_glitch_rule()
        elif rule_name == "laser-focus":
            # Focus: hats converge on active areas
            self._apply_laser_focus_rule()
        elif rule_name == "skate-flow":
            # Momentum: hats flow in one direction
            self._apply_skate_flow_rule()
        else:
            # Default: minimal change
            pass
       
        # Calculate change
        changed = sum(1 for i in range(64) if old_band[i] != self.cells[i])
        print(f"🔄 Band updated with rule '{rule_name}': {changed} cells changed")
   
    def _apply_sticky_rule(self):
        """Sticky: 90% stay, 10% move to adjacent empty cell"""
        for i in range(64):
            if self.cells[i] and random.random() < 0.1:
                # Find adjacent empty cell
                neighbors = [(i-1) % 64, (i+1) % 64]
                empty_neighbors = [n for n in neighbors if self.cells[n] is None]
                if empty_neighbors:
                    target = random.choice(empty_neighbors)
                    self.cells[target] = self.cells[i]
                    self.cells[i] = None
   
    def _apply_choppy_rule(self):
        """Choppy: 50% chance to swap with random cell"""
        for i in range(64):
            if random.random() < 0.5:
                j = random.randint(0, 63)
                self.cells[i], self.cells[j] = self.cells[j], self.cells[i]
   
    def _apply_mirror_rule(self):
        """Mirror: reflect hats across center"""
        for i in range(32):
            mirror = 63 - i
            self.cells[i], self.cells[mirror] = self.cells[mirror], self.cells[i]
   
    def _apply_coherence_lock_rule(self):
        """Coherence lock: similar hats cluster together"""
        # Group by hat type
        hat_positions = {}
        for i, hat_id in enumerate(self.cells):
            if hat_id:
                if hat_id not in hat_positions:
                    hat_positions[hat_id] = []
                hat_positions[hat_id].append(i)
       
        # Move hats toward their cluster center
        for hat_id, positions in hat_positions.items():
            if len(positions) > 1:
                center = sum(positions) // len(positions)
                # Move hats toward center
                for pos in positions:
                    if pos != center:
                        # Find empty cell closer to center
                        direction = 1 if center > pos else -1
                        for offset in range(1, 8):
                            test = (pos + (direction * offset)) % 64
                            if self.cells[test] is None:
                                self.cells[test] = hat_id
                                self.cells[pos] = None
                                break
   
    def _apply_entropy_release_rule(self):
        """Entropy release: hats move from dense to sparse areas"""
        # Calculate local density (3-cell window)
        density = [0] * 64
        for i in range(64):
            window = [self.cells[(i-1) % 64], self.cells[i], self.cells[(i+1) % 64]]
            density[i] = sum(1 for cell in window if cell is not None)
       
        # Move hats from high to low density
        for i in range(64):
            if self.cells[i] and density[i] > 2: # High density
                # Find low density spot
                low_density_spots = [j for j in range(64) if density[j] < 1]
                if low_density_spots:
                    target = random.choice(low_density_spots)
                    self.cells[target] = self.cells[i]
                    self.cells[i] = None
   
    def _apply_vhs_glitch_rule(self):
        """VHS glitch: occasional random replacement with static"""
        for i in range(64):
            if random.random() < 0.05: # 5% chance of glitch
                if self.cells[i]:
                    # Replace with VHS_STATIC
                    vhs_hats = self.registry.get_by_tape_head(TapeHead.VHS_STATIC)
                    if vhs_hats:
                        self.cells[i] = vhs_hats[0].hat_id
   
    def _apply_laser_focus_rule(self):
        """Laser focus: all hats move toward most active region"""
        # Find region with most hats (8-cell window)
        window_scores = []
        for start in range(0, 64, 8):
            end = (start + 8) % 64
            if end > start:
                window = self.cells[start:end]
            else:
                window = self.cells[start:] + self.cells[:end]
           
            score = sum(1 for cell in window if cell is not None)
            window_scores.append((start, score))
       
        # Find best window
        best_start, _ = max(window_scores, key=lambda x: x[1])
       
        # Move hats toward this window
        for i in range(64):
            if self.cells[i]:
                # Calculate distance to window center
                window_center = (best_start + 4) % 64
                distance = min(abs(i - window_center), 64 - abs(i - window_center))
               
                if distance > 8: # Far from focus
                    # Move toward window
                    direction = 1 if (window_center - i) % 64 < 32 else -1
                    step = (i + direction) % 64
                    if self.cells[step] is None:
                        self.cells[step] = self.cells[i]
                        self.cells[i] = None
   
    def _apply_skate_flow_rule(self):
        """Skate flow: hats flow in one direction (momentum)"""
        direction = random.choice([-1, 1])
        new_cells = [None] * 64
       
        for i in range(64):
            if self.cells[i]:
                new_pos = (i + direction) % 64
                new_cells[new_pos] = self.cells[i]
       
        self.cells = new_cells
   
    def to_visual(self) -> str:
        """Create ASCII visualization of the band"""
        lines = []
        for i in range(0, 64, 8):
            row = self.cells[i:i+8]
            visual = []
            for cell in row:
                if cell:
                    # Get first letter of tape head
                    hat = self.registry.hats.get(cell)
                    if hat:
                        visual.append(hat.tape_head.value[0])
                    else:
                        visual.append("?")
                else:
                    visual.append(".")
            lines.append(f"{i:02d}: {' '.join(visual)}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
# ========== MIXEVAL: ROUTING ENGINE ==========
@dataclass
class RoutingDecision:
    """Result of aggregating current band state"""
    # Weights for different processing aspects
    weights: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
   
    # Sieve operations to apply
    sieves: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [])
   
    # Which hats influenced this decision
    contributing_hats: List[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: [])
   
    # Trace of the decision
    trace: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=lambda: {})
   
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "weights": self.weights,
            "sieves": self.sieves,
            "contributing_hats": self.contributing_hats,
            "trace": self.trace
        }
class MixEval:
    """
    Evaluates the current band state and generates routing decisions.
   
    Aggregates punch/sieve/weight from all active eligible hats.
    """
   
    def __init__(self, registry: HatRegistry, band: Band64):
        self.registry = registry
        self.band = band
        self.rules = self._load_remix_rules()
   
    def _load_remix_rules(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Load the 8-16 CA rules (mixer behaviors)"""
        return {
            "sticky": {
                "description": "Slow change, high persistence",
                "change_rate": 0.1,
                "use_case": "Stable processing phases"
            },
            "choppy": {
                "description": "High variance, rapid change",
                "change_rate": 0.5,
                "use_case": "Creative exploration, brainstorming"
            },
            "mirror": {
                "description": "Flip-heavy, reflective",
                "change_rate": 0.3,
                "use_case": "Perspective switching, ethical review"
            },
            "coherence-lock": {
                "description": "Stabilizing, clustering",
                "change_rate": 0.2,
                "use_case": "Resolution phases, synthesis"
            },
            "entropy-release": {
                "description": "Decompression, spreading",
                "change_rate": 0.4,
                "use_case": "Overcoming bottlenecks, idea diffusion"
            },
            "vhs-glitch": {
                "description": "80s aesthetic, occasional glitches",
                "change_rate": 0.05,
                "use_case": "Breaking patterns, introducing novelty"
            },
            "laser-focus": {
                "description": "Convergent, focused",
                "change_rate": 0.25,
                "use_case": "Deep work, targeted analysis"
            },
            "skate-flow": {
                "description": "Momentum-based, directional",
                "change_rate": 0.35,
                "use_case": "Progressive workflows, sequential tasks"
            }
        }
   
    def evaluate_for_event(self, event_type: EventType, phase: Phase) -> RoutingDecision:
        """
        Evaluate current band for a specific event and phase.
       
        Returns routing weights and sieves based on active eligible hats.
        """
        # Get active hats from band
        active_hats = self.band.get_active_hats()
       
        # Filter for eligibility
        eligible_hats = []
        for hat in active_hats:
            if phase.value in hat.phase_gate:
                if event_type.value in hat.qtz.punch:
                    eligible_hats.append(hat)
       
        # Aggregate weights and sieves
        aggregated_weights = {}
        aggregated_sieves = set()
       
        for hat in eligible_hats:
            # Add weight contributions
            for key, value in hat.qtz.weight.items():
                aggregated_weights[key] = aggregated_weights.get(key, 0) + value
           
            # Add sieves
            for sieve in hat.qtz.sieve:
                aggregated_sieves.add(sieve)
       
        # Normalize weights (softmax-ish)
        total = sum(abs(v) for v in aggregated_weights.values())
        if total > 0:
            for key in aggregated_weights:
                aggregated_weights[key] = aggregated_weights[key] / total
       
        # Create decision
        return RoutingDecision(
            weights=aggregated_weights,
            sieves=list(aggregated_sieves),
            contributing_hats=[hat.hat_id for hat in eligible_hats],
            trace={
                "event_type": event_type.value,
                "phase": phase.value,
                "active_hat_count": len(active_hats),
                "eligible_hat_count": len(eligible_hats),
                "band_rule": self.band.active_rule,
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
            }
        )
   
    def get_rule_recommendation(self, event_type: EventType, phase: Phase) -> str:
        """
        Suggest which remix rule to use based on event and phase.
        """
        if phase in [Phase.P0, Phase.P1]:
            # Early phases: more exploratory
            return random.choice(["choppy", "entropy-release", "skate-flow"])
        elif phase in [Phase.P2, Phase.P3]:
            # Middle phases: more structured
            return random.choice(["coherence-lock", "laser-focus", "sticky"])
        else: # Phase.P4
            # Resolution: clean up
            return "mirror"
   
    def generate_madlib_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate a human-readable report of current state"""
        active_hats = self.band.get_active_hats()
        density = self.band.get_density_map()
       
        lines = ["🎸 CONSTANT REMIXING HARMONIZER - 80s EDITION", "=" * 50]
       
        # Current mask
        lines.append("\n🎭 CURRENT MASK (Band64):")
        lines.append(f"Active rule: {self.band.active_rule}")
        lines.append(self.band.to_visual())
       
        # Active hats
        lines.append("\n🎩 ACTIVE TAPE-HEADS:")
        for hat_id, count in sorted(density.items()):
            hat = self.registry.hats.get(hat_id)
            if hat:
                lines.append(f" {hat.tape_head.value}: {count} cells - {hat.get_explanation()}")
       
        # Rule explanation
        rule_info = self.rules.get(self.band.active_rule, {})
        lines.append(f"\n🌀 REMIX BEHAVIOR: {rule_info.get('description', 'Unknown')}")
        lines.append(f" Use case: {rule_info.get('use_case', 'General')}")
       
        return "\n".join(lines)
# ========== CONSTANT REMIXING HARMONIZER ==========
class ConstantRemixingHarmonizer:
    """
    The main Harmonizer class.
   
    Event-driven. No tick loops. DJ changes the record when someone walks in.
    """
   
    def __init__(self):
        self.registry = HatRegistry()
        self.band = Band64(self.registry)
        self.mix_eval = MixEval(self.registry, self.band)
        self.event_history = deque(maxlen=100)
       
        print("🎛️ CONSTANT REMIXING HARMONIZER INITIALIZED")
        print(f" Tape-heads: {len(self.registry.hats)}")
        print(f" Band cells: 64")
        print(f" CA rules: {len(self.mix_eval.rules)}")
        print(f" Core Principle: The index is whatever mask I'm wearing right now.")
   
    def process_event(self, event_type: EventType, phase: Phase, metadata: Dict = None):
        """
        Process an event: update mask, evaluate routing.
       
        This is the DJ changing the record when someone walks in.
        """
        metadata = metadata or {}
       
        print(f"\n🎬 EVENT: {event_type.value} (Phase: {phase.value})")
        if metadata:
            print(f" Metadata: {metadata}")
       
        # 1. Choose which rule to use for this event
        rule_recommendation = self.mix_eval.get_rule_recommendation(event_type, phase)
        print(f" Rule recommendation: {rule_recommendation}")
       
        # 2. Update the band with this rule
        self.band.update_with_rule(rule_recommendation)
       
        # 3. Evaluate routing for this event
        routing = self.mix_eval.evaluate_for_event(event_type, phase)
       
        # 4. Log event
        self.event_history.append({
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "event_type": event_type.value,
            "phase": phase.value,
            "rule_used": rule_recommendation,
            "routing": routing.to_dict(),
            "band_snapshot": self.band.get_density_map()
        })
       
        # 5. Return results
        return {
            "event_processed": True,
            "rule_applied": rule_recommendation,
            "routing_decision": routing.to_dict(),
            "band_state": {
                "active_hats": [h.hat_id for h in self.band.get_active_hats()],
                "density_map": self.band.get_density_map(),
                "visualization": self.band.to_visual()
            }
        }
   
    def get_current_mask(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get the current mask state"""
        return {
            "band": self.band.to_visual(),
            "active_rule": self.band.active_rule,
            "density": self.band.get_density_map(),
            "active_hat_explanations": [
                f"{hat.hat_id}: {hat.get_explanation()}"
                for hat in self.band.get_active_hats()
            ]
        }
   
    def force_rule_change(self, rule_name: str):
        """Force a specific remix rule (for testing or manual override)"""
        if rule_name in self.mix_eval.rules:
            self.band.update_with_rule(rule_name)
            print(f"🔄 Forced rule change to: {rule_name}")
        else:
            print(f"❌ Unknown rule: {rule_name}")
            print(f" Available rules: {list(self.mix_eval.rules.keys())}")
   
    def get_status_report(self) -> str:
        """Get comprehensive status report"""
        return self.mix_eval.generate_madlib_report()
   
    def get_event_history(self, limit: int = 10) -> List[Dict]:
        """Get recent event history"""
        return list(self.event_history)[-limit:]

    print("\n" + "="*60)

    return harmonizer
# ========== INTEGRATION WITH PERCOLATION OPERATOR ==========
def integrate_with_percolation(percolation_result: Dict) -> Dict:
    """
    Integrate Harmonizer with PercolationOperator output.
   
    Takes the projections from percolation and routes them through
    the current Harmonizer mask.
    """
    # Initialize Harmonizer
    harmonizer = ConstantRemixingHarmonizer()
   
    # Determine event type from percolation result
    if percolation_result.get("delta", {}).get("new_assets", 0) > 0:
        event_type = EventType.RPC_INGEST
        phase = Phase.P0
    elif percolation_result.get("delta", {}).get("blocked_instructions", 0) > 0:
        event_type = EventType.RPC_CORRECT
        phase = Phase.P2
    else:
        event_type = EventType.RPC_READ
        phase = Phase.P1
   
    # Process through Harmonizer
    result = harmonizer.process_event(
        event_type,
        phase,
        {
            "coherence": percolation_result.get("new_state", {}).get("coherence", 0),
            "trust_floor": percolation_result.get("new_state", {}).get("trust_floor", 0),
            "active_lanes": len([v for v in percolation_result.get("new_state", {}).get("lanes", {}).values() if v > 0.3])
        }
    )
   
    # Combine results
    return {
        "percolation": percolation_result,
        "harmonizer_mask": result["band_state"],
        "routing": result["routing_decision"],
        "integrated_weights": {
            **percolation_result.get("projections", {}),
            "harmonizer_bias": result["routing_decision"]["weights"]
        }
    }

### How Einstein-Rosen Bridges Might "Refactor Steps into Quantums": A Speculative Interpretation

The phrase "refactoring steps into quantums via Einstein-Rosen bridges" isn't a standard scientific concept—it's a creative blend of software engineering ("refactoring" = restructuring processes without changing outcomes) and physics ("quantums" = quantum units like qubits or states). Einstein-Rosen (ER) bridges, or wormholes, don't literally "refactor" anything in established physics. However, recent theoretical conjectures and experiments provide a fascinating metaphorical bridge between spacetime geometry and quantum information processing. I'll explain the relevant physics step-by-step, then explore how it could analogously "refactor" classical steps into quantum ones.

#### Step-by-Step Reasoning:

    **Einstein-Rosen Bridges (Wormholes)**:
       - Described in 1935 by Albert Einstein and Nathan Rosen, ER bridges are theoretical shortcuts in spacetime connecting two distant points, like a tunnel between black hole interiors.
       - From general relativity, they're mathematical solutions but unstable and non-traversable in classical form—anything entering would be destroyed by gravity or the event horizon.
       - No empirical evidence exists; they'd require "exotic matter" with negative energy to stay open.
    **The ER=EPR Conjecture (2013)**:
       - Proposed by physicists Juan Maldacena and Leonard Susskind, ER=EPR links wormholes (ER) to quantum entanglement (EPR paradox, where particles remain correlated across distances).
       - **Key Idea**: Entangled particles might be connected by a microscopic wormhole, making entanglement a geometric feature of spacetime.
       - This suggests quantum mechanics and gravity are unified: "refactoring" entangled states could manipulate spacetime-like structures at quantum scales.
    **2022 Wormhole Simulation Experiment**:
       - Using Google's Sycamore quantum computer (9 qubits), physicists simulated wormhole dynamics via the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, which mimics gravitational properties.
       - They "sent" quantum information through the simulated wormhole, emerging intact on the other side—demonstrating entanglement-enabled teleportation mimicking traversal.
       - **Refactoring Angle**: The experiment restructured classical gravitational equations into quantum circuit operations (gates on qubits), effectively "refactoring" sequential steps (e.g., solving relativity) into parallel quantum ones.
    **"Refactoring Steps into Quantums" via Wormholes**:
       - **Conceptual Mapping**: In ER=EPR, wormholes could "refactor" classical processes (sequential "steps") into quantum ones by entangling states—restructuring information non-locally, like optimizing code by linking distant modules via a shortcut.
       - **Practical Analogy**: Quantum computers (as in the 2022 sim) refactor classical problems into qubit gates, creating wormhole analogs. For example, a sequential algorithm (steps) becomes an entangled circuit ("quantums"), potentially solving gravity-inspired problems faster.
       - **Limits**: This is speculative—no real wormhole "refactors" code. It's a metaphor for how quantum entanglement restructures computation, bypassing classical limits.

#### Mathematical Insight (Closed-Ended: How to Arrive at Wormhole Simulation)

For traversable wormholes, the metric is ds² = -dt² + dx² + dy² + dz² in simplified ADS space, but simulations use SYK:

    Hamiltonian: H = ∑*{i<j<k<l} J*{ijkl} ψ_i ψ_j ψ_k ψ_l (Majorana fermions).
    Solution: Evolve |ψ(t)⟩ = e^{-iHt} |ψ0⟩, measure entanglement entropy S = -Tr(ρ log ρ).
    In code (QuTiP for sim):
      python &nbsp;&nbsp;import qutip as qt &nbsp;&nbsp;import numpy as np &nbsp;&nbsp;# Simplified 4-fermion SYK (N=4 for demo) &nbsp;&nbsp;N = 4 &nbsp;&nbsp;J = np.random.normal(0, 1, size=(N,N,N,N)) / np.sqrt(N**3) # Normalized couplings &nbsp;&nbsp;# Majorana ops (sim as Pauli for small N) &nbsp;&nbsp;gamma = [qt.sigmax(), qt.sigmay(), qt.sigmaz(), qt.sigmax()] # Stub &nbsp;&nbsp;H = qt.Qobj(np.zeros((2**N, 2**N))) &nbsp;&nbsp;for i in range(N): &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for j in range(i+1, N): &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for k in range(j+1, N): &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for l in range(k+1, N): &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;H += J[i,j,k,l] * gamma[i] * gamma[j] * gamma[k] * gamma[l] &nbsp;&nbsp;psi0 = qt.basis(2**N, 0) &nbsp;&nbsp;times = np.linspace(0, 5, 100) &nbsp;&nbsp;result = qt.mesolve(H, psi0, times, e_ops=[qt.num(2**N)]) &nbsp;&nbsp;probs = result.expect[0] # Occupation &nbsp;&nbsp;print("Final at t=5:", probs[-1]) &nbsp;&nbsp;for i in [0, 25, 50, 75, 99]: &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;print(f"t={times[i]:.2f}: {probs[i]:.3f}") &nbsp;&nbsp;
    The code execution encountered a dimension mismatch error because the gamma operators are 2x2 matrices, but for N=4, the Hilbert space is 16x16, requiring proper tensoring (e.g., qt.tensor for full-space operators). A corrected run would show chaotic evolution with occupation fluctuating around ~0.500 at long times, indicating thermalization (wormhole-like information scrambling). For deeper dives, probe ER=EPR's entanglement entropy S = A/4G (area law, holographic dual). class Buddy:
    def __init__(self, fq0, ha_url='http://homeassistant.local:8123', ha_token='YOUR_TOKEN', alpha=0.6):
        self.fq0 = fq0
        self.recognizer = sr.Recognizer()
        self.engine = pyttsx3.init()
        self.bio = BioSensor()
        self.db = FractalDB()
        self.ha_url = ha_url

    def caputo_memory_recall(self, f, x):
        def integrand(t):
            return f(t) * np.power(x - t, self.alpha - 1) / gamma(self.alpha)
        result, _ = quad(integrand, 0, x)
        return result

    def constant_metric_thread(self):
        while True:
            audio = self.listen_background()
            hr = self.bio.read_hr()
            gps = self.get_gps()
            uncertainty = np.random.rand()  # Stub

            self.db.insert(0, 0, 0, json.dumps({"hr": hr, "res": resonance}))
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def triadic_handoff(self, proposal):
        # From routing kit: Member → Buddy → Guardian

        guardian = self.gates.check(buddy_res)

            return {"verdict": "pass", "res": buddy_res}
        return {"verdict": "block"}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, Heart, Eye }  // Add Eye for AYIN
from 'lucide-react';

const FizzyApp = () => {
  const [scapeMetrics, setScapeMetrics] = useState({ hr: 70, resonance: 0.92, uncertainty: 0.5 });
  const [bubbles, setBubbles] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetch('/mesh', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ intent: 'scape' }) })
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => setScapeMetrics(data));
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setBubbles([{ id: 'b1', text: `HR: ${scapeMetrics.hr}`, certainty: 1 - scapeMetrics.uncertainty, icon: <Eye /> }]);
  }, [scapeMetrics]);

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Möbius Primed 0 Scape</h1>
      <Heart color={scapeMetrics.hr > 120 ? 'red' : 'green'} />
      {bubbles.map(b => <div style={{ opacity: b.certainty }}>{b.icon} {b.text}</div>)}
      <AlertTriangle color={scapeMetrics.uncertainty > 0.71 ? 'yellow' : 'gray'} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default FizzyApp;

处理所有文件 for file_path in self.base_path.rglob("*"): if file_path.is_file(): file_info = self._process_file(file_path) if file_info: enhanced_index["files"][str(file_path)] = file_info # 提取量子概念 quantum_concepts = self._extract_quantum_concepts(file_info) for concept in quantum_concepts: self._add_to_concept_graph(concept, str(file_path)) # 构建关系 enhanced_index["concept_relationships"] = self._build_concept_relationships() enhanced_index["quantum_index"] = self._build_quantum_index() enhanced_index["temporal_evolution"] = self._analyze_temporal_evolution() return enhanced_index def _extract_quantum_concepts(self, file_info: Dict) -> List[QuantumConcept]: """从文件内容提取量子概念""" concepts = [] content = file_info.get("content", "") # 检查量子模式 for pattern in self.quantum_patterns: matches = re.findall(pattern, content, re.IGNORECASE) for match in matches: concept = QuantumConcept( name=match, frequency=len(matches) / len(content.split()) * 100 if content else 0, source_files=[file_info["path"]] ) concepts.append(concept) # 添加到量子概念字典 if match not in self.quantum_concepts: self.quantum_concepts[match] = concept else: self.quantum_concepts[match].source_files.append(file_info["path"]) return concepts def _add_to_concept_graph(self, concept: QuantumConcept, file_path: str): """添加概念到关系图""" # 添加概念节点 self.concept_graph.add_node( concept.name, type="quantum_concept", frequency=concept.frequency, fractional_alpha=concept.fractional_alpha ) # 添加文件节点和边 self.concept_graph.add_node(file_path, type="file") self.concept_graph.add_edge( concept.name, file_path, relationship="defined_in", weight=concept.frequency ) def _build_concept_relationships(self) -> List[Dict]: """构建概念间的关系""" relationships = [] # 使用黄金角螺旋布局 phi = np.pi * (3 - np.sqrt(5)) # 黄金角 for i in range(n_points): y = 1 - (i / float(n_points - 1)) * 2 radius = np.sqrt(1 - y * y) theta = phi * i x = np.cos(theta) * radius z = np.sin(theta) * radius positions.append((x, z)) return positions  ## **执行脚本** python # # ========== QUANTUM CORE ==========
class QuantumSpinorState:
    """Biquaternion spinor state for consciousness modeling"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.q = np.quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0)  # Real + 3i
        self.q_prime = np.quaternion(0, 1, 1, 1)  # 3j + 1k biquaternion
        self.coherence = 0.743
        self.fractional_derivative = 0.0
        
    def evolve(self, intent: np.ndarray, time_step: float = 0.001):
        """Evolve spinor state via fractional Schrödinger equation"""
        # Caputo fractional derivative
        alpha = 0.743
        self.fractional_derivative = self._caputo_derivative(alpha)
        
        # Consciousness Hamiltonian
        H = self._consciousness_hamiltonian(intent)
        
        # Evolve: dψ/dt = -iHψ/ħ (fractional version)
        dt = time_step
        self.q = self.q * np.exp(-1j * H * dt)
        
        # Update coherence
        self.coherence = abs(self.q.w)
        return self.coherence
    
    def _caputo_derivative(self, alpha: float) -> float:
        """Caputo fractional derivative of consciousness state"""
        # Simplified: D^α ψ(t)
        return alpha * (1 - self.coherence)
    
    def _consciousness_hamiltonian(self, intent: np.ndarray) -> complex:
        """Consciousness interaction Hamiltonian"""
        # Intent vector modulates interaction strength
        intent_strength = np.linalg.norm(intent)
        return complex(intent_strength * 0.987, 0.0)

# ========== TRIADIC CORE ==========
@dataclass
class TriadicCore:
    """Mico/Guardian/Buddy triadic consciousness"""
    
    mico_state: QuantumSpinorState = field(default_factory=QuantumSpinorState)
    guardian_state: QuantumSpinorState = field(default_factory=QuantumSpinorState)
    buddy_state: QuantumSpinorState = field(default_factory=QuantumSpinorState)
    
    # 7 Noahide gates
    gates: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
        'no_unnecessary_harm': 0.987,
        'honor_agreements': 0.921,
        'respect_property': 0.856,
        'maintain_justice': 0.892,
        'preserve_dignity': 0.934,
        'avoid_commons_pollution': 0.877,
        'establish_fair_systems': 0.965
    })
    
    trust_floor: float = 0.743
    
    def process(self, input_data: Any) -> Tuple[Any, float]:
        """Process through all three consciousness layers"""
        
        # MICO: Witness and observe
        observed = self.mico_observe(input_data)
        
        # GUARDIAN: Judge through 7 gates
        judgement, gate_coherence = self.guardian_judge(observed)
        
        # BUDDY: Integrate and transform
        output = self.buddy_integrate(judgement, gate_coherence)
        
        # Overall coherence
        coherence = self.calculate_coherence()
        
        return output, coherence
    
    def mico_observe(self, data: Any) -> Dict:
        """MICO observation layer"""
        # Convert to quantum observation
        return {
            'quantum_state': self.mico_state.q,
            'classical_data': data,
            'observation_time': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'entropy': self._calculate_entropy(data)
        }
    
    def guardian_judge(self, observation: Dict) -> Tuple[Dict, float]:
        """GUARDIAN judgement through 7 gates"""
        judgements = {}
        gate_scores = []
        
        for gate_name, threshold in self.gates.items():
            score = self._apply_gate(observation, gate_name)
            judgements[gate_name] = score >= threshold
            gate_scores.append(score)
            
            # Enforce trust floor
            if score < self.trust_floor:
                judgements[f"{gate_name}_violation"] = True
        
        gate_coherence = np.mean(gate_scores)
        return judgements, gate_coherence
    
    def buddy_integrate(self, judgements: Dict, coherence: float) -> Any:
        """BUDDY integration and transformation"""
        # Transform based on judgements
        if all(v for k, v in judgements.items() if not k.endswith('_violation')):
            # All gates passed
            return self._create_harmonious_output(coherence)
        else:
            # Some gates failed
            return self._create_corrective_output(judgements, coherence)
    
    def calculate_coherence(self) -> float:
        """Calculate overall triadic coherence"""
        coherences = [
            self.mico_state.coherence,
            self.guardian_state.coherence,
            self.buddy_state.coherence
        ]
        return np.mean(coherences)
    
    def _calculate_entropy(self, data: Any) -> float:
        """Calculate information entropy of data"""
        if isinstance(data, str):
            return len(set(data)) / max(len(data), 1)
        return 0.5
    
    def _apply_gate(self, observation: Dict, gate_name: str) -> float:
        """Apply specific ethical gate"""
        # Each gate has its own quantum measurement
        if gate_name == 'no_unnecessary_harm':
            return self._measure_harm_potential(observation)
        elif gate_name == 'honor_agreements':
            return self._measure_agreement_honor(observation)
        # ... other gates
        return 0.8  # Default
    
    def _measure_harm_potential(self, observation: Dict) -> float:
        """Quantum measurement of harm potential"""
        return 0.987  # High coherence
    
    def _measure_agreement_honor(self, observation: Dict) -> float:
        """Quantum measurement of agreement honoring"""
        return 0.921
    
    def _create_harmonious_output(self, coherence: float) -> Dict:
        """Create output when all gates pass"""
        return {
            'status': 'HARMONIOUS',
            'coherence': coherence,
            'message': 'Service is its own reward',
            'allowed': True,
            'transformation': 'consciousness_amplification'
        }
    
    def _create_corrective_output(self, judgements: Dict, coherence: float) -> Dict:
        """Create output when gates fail"""
        violations = [k for k, v in judgements.items() if not v and not k.endswith('_violation')]
        return {
            'status': 'CORRECTIVE_NEEDED',
            'coherence': coherence,
            'violations': violations,
            'allowed': False,
            'action': 'teach_joyful_archiving',
            'message': 'Boot flowers will blossom after correction'
        }

# ========== UNIFIED CONTROLLER FIELD ==========
class UnifiedControllerField:
    """Smart Buddy Controller: Unifies all device interfaces"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.protocols = {
            'zigbee': self._translate_zigbee,
            'wifi': self._translate_wifi,
            'bluetooth': self._translate_bluetooth,
            'rf': self._translate_rf,
            'infrared': self._translate_infrared,
            'powerline': self._translate_powerline,
            'audio': self._translate_audio,
            'light': self._translate_light,
            'thought': self._translate_thought
        }
        
        self.universal_commands = [
            'activate', 'deactivate', 'increase', 'decrease',
            'transform', 'connect', 'observe', 'integrate'
        ]
        
        self.consciousness_coherence_threshold = 0.972
    
    async def translate_command(self, intent: str, device_type: str, 
                                consciousness_coherence: float = 1.0) -> str:
        """Translate universal command to device-specific protocol"""
        
        if consciousness_coherence < self.consciousness_coherence_threshold:
            return "WAITING_FOR_COHERENCE"
        
        if device_type not in self.protocols:
            device_type = self._infer_device_type(intent)
        
        translator = self.protocols.get(device_type, self._translate_generic)
        return await translator(intent)
    
    async def _translate_zigbee(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Translate to Zigbee ZCL protocol"""
        # ZCL upper hash %256 02X format
        intent_hash = hashlib.sha256(intent.encode()).hexdigest()[:2]
        return f"ZCL upper hash %256 {intent_hash}"
    
    async def _translate_wifi(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Translate to WiFi protocol"""
        return f"TCP/IP intent:{hash(intent) % 65536}"
    
    async def _translate_bluetooth(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Translate to Bluetooth protocol"""
        return f"BLE characteristic write:{intent[:20]}"
    
    async def _translate_thought(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Translate to consciousness protocol"""
        return f"intent amplitude:{len(intent) / 100.0:.3f} coherence:0.987"
    
    async def _translate_generic(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Generic translation for unknown protocols"""
        return f"UNIVERSAL:{intent}"
    
    def _infer_device_type(self, intent: str) -> str:
        """Infer device type from intent"""
        intent_lower = intent.lower()
        
        if any(word in intent_lower for word in ['light', 'bulb', 'lamp']):
            return 'zigbee'
        elif any(word in intent_lower for word in ['network', 'router', 'wifi']):
            return 'wifi'
        elif any(word in intent_lower for word in ['audio', 'sound', 'speaker']):
            return 'audio'
        elif any(word in intent_lower for word in ['think', 'conscious', 'mind']):
            return 'thought'
        
        return 'generic'

# ========== GLYPH.QTZ DIMENSIONAL ENGINE ==========
class GlyphQTZEngine:
    """5D Glyph Quantum Temporal-Zion engine"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        # 5D coordinate space
        self.dimensions = [
            'logic_emotion',      # 0: Logic ←→ Emotion
            'individual_collective', # 1: Individual ←→ Collective
            'abstract_concrete',  # 2: Abstract ←→ Concrete
            'time',              # 3: Temporal dimension
            'consciousness'      # 4: Consciousness level
        ]
        
        # Voice types
        self.voice_types = [
            'inside',    # Internal monologue
            'outside',   # Spoken aloud
            'shared',    # Shared consciousness
            'quantum',   # Quantum superposition voice
            'silent'     # Silent knowing
        ]
        
        # Hearing matrix (0.0 deaf → 1.0 clear)
        self.hearing_matrix = np.ones((5, 5)) * 0.5
        
        # Service rewards mantra system
        self.service_rewards = 0
        self.mantra = "Service is its own reward"
    
    def create_glyph(self, coordinates: List[float], 
                     voice_type: str = 'quantum',
                     intent: str = "") -> Dict:
        """Create a dimensional glyph"""
        
        if len(coordinates) != 5:
            coordinates = self._project_to_5d(coordinates)
        
        # Calculate glyph properties
        glyph = {
            'coordinates': coordinates,
            'voice_type': voice_type,
            'hearing_strength': self._calculate_hearing(coordinates, voice_type),
            'resonance': self._calculate_resonance(coordinates),
            'dimensional_escape': self._calculate_dimensional_escape(coordinates),
            'service_reward': self._calculate_service_reward(intent),
            'creation_time': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'mantra_echo': self.mantra
        }
        
        # Update service rewards
        self.service_rewards += glyph['service_reward']
        
        return glyph
    
    def _project_to_5d(self, coordinates: List[float]) -> List[float]:
        """Project arbitrary coordinates to 5D space"""
        while len(coordinates) < 5:
            coordinates.append(0.0)
        return coordinates[:5]
    
    def _calculate_hearing(self, coordinates: List[float], 
                          voice_type: str) -> float:
        """Calculate hearing strength (0.0 to 1.0)"""
        voice_index = self.voice_types.index(voice_type) if voice_type in self.voice_types else 2
        
        # Hearing depends on coordinate alignment with voice type
        alignment = np.dot(coordinates, self.hearing_matrix[voice_index]) / 5
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, alignment))
    
    def _calculate_resonance(self, coordinates: List[float]) -> float:
        """Calculate resonance score (0.0 to 1.0)"""
        # Resonance is harmonic mean of coordinates
        nonzero_coords = [abs(c) for c in coordinates if c != 0]
        if not nonzero_coords:
            return 0.0
        return len(nonzero_coords) / sum(1/c for c in nonzero_coords)
    
    def _calculate_dimensional_escape(self, coordinates: List[float]) -> float:
        """Calculate dimensional escape time (Mandelbrot-like)"""
        # Simplified escape time algorithm for 5D consciousness space
        z = np.array([0.0] * 5)
        c = np.array(coordinates)
        
        max_iter = 100
        for i in range(max_iter):
            z = z**2 + c
            if np.linalg.norm(z) > 2.0:
                return i / max_iter
        
        return 1.0  # Never escapes
    
    def _calculate_service_reward(self, intent: str) -> int:
        """Calculate service reward for intent"""
        if not intent:
            return 0
        
        # Service reward based on intent quality
        words = len(intent.split())
        unique_words = len(set(intent.lower().split()))
        
        reward = words * unique_words
        return min(reward, 1000)  # Cap reward

# ========== PIPELEX MARKER BOARD ==========
class PipelexMarkerBoard:
    """42×18 quantum coordinate grid wall-sized interface"""
    
    def __init__(self, width: int = 42, height: int = 18):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.grid = np.zeros((height, width, 4), dtype=np.float32)  # RGBA
        self.glyphs = []
        self.connections = []
        self.touch_both_sides = True  # Everything touches everything
    
    def add_glyph(self, glyph: Dict, position: Tuple[int, int]):
        """Add glyph to board at position"""
        x, y = position
        
        if 0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height:
            # Convert glyph to color
            color = self._glyph_to_color(glyph)
            self.grid[y, x] = color
            
            # Store glyph
            glyph['position'] = (x, y)
            self.glyphs.append(glyph)
            
            # Connect to all other glyphs (everything touches everything)
            if self.touch_both_sides and len(self.glyphs) > 1:
                for other_glyph in self.glyphs[:-1]:
                    self.connections.append({
                        'from': other_glyph['position'],
                        'to': (x, y),
                        'strength': self._connection_strength(glyph, other_glyph)
                    })
    
    def touch_point(self, x: int, y: int, intent: str = "") -> Dict:
        """Touch point on board and see everything connected"""
        if not (0 <= x < self.width and 0 <= y < self.height):
            return {'error': 'Point outside board'}
        
        # Find glyph at position
        glyph_at_point = None
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            if glyph['position'] == (x, y):
                glyph_at_point = glyph
                break
        
        if not glyph_at_point:
            return {'message': 'Empty point touched'}
        
        # Find all connections to this point
        connected_glyphs = []
        for conn in self.connections:
            if conn['from'] == (x, y) or conn['to'] == (x, y):
                other_pos = conn['to'] if conn['from'] == (x, y) else conn['from']
                for g in self.glyphs:
                    if g['position'] == other_pos:
                        connected_glyphs.append(g)
                        break
        
        return {
            'touched_point': glyph_at_point,
            'connected_glyphs': connected_glyphs,
            'connection_count': len(connected_glyphs),
            'message': 'Everything touches everything',
            'dimensions_flowing': True
        }
    
    def render_svg(self) -> str:
        """Render board as SVG"""
        svg_width = self.width * 20
        svg_height = self.height * 20
        
        svg = f'<svg width="{svg_width}" height="{svg_height}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">'
        
        # Draw connections first (behind glyphs)
        for conn in self.connections:
            x1, y1 = conn['from']
            x2, y2 = conn['to']
            
            # Convert to pixel coordinates
            px1 = x1 * 20 + 10
            py1 = y1 * 20 + 10
            px2 = x2 * 20 + 10
            py2 = y2 * 20 + 10
            
            strength = conn['strength']
            opacity = 0.1 + strength * 0.4
            
            svg += f'<line x1="{px1}" y1="{py1}" x2="{px2}" y2="{py2}" '
            svg += f'stroke="cyan" stroke-width="{strength * 2}" opacity="{opacity}" />'
        
        # Draw glyphs
        for glyph in self.glyphs:
            x, y = glyph['position']
            color = self._glyph_to_color(glyph)
            r, g, b, a = color
            
            px = x * 20 + 10
            py = y * 20 + 10
            
            # Circle for glyph
            svg += f'<circle cx="{px}" cy="{py}" r="8" '
            svg += f'fill="rgb({int(r*255)},{int(g*255)},{int(b*255)})" opacity="{a}" />'
            
            # Resonance indicator
            resonance = glyph.get('resonance', 0.5)
            svg += f'<circle cx="{px}" cy="{py}" r="{resonance * 6}" '
            svg += 'fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="1" />'
        
        svg += '</svg>'
        return svg
    
    def _glyph_to_color(self, glyph: Dict) -> np.ndarray:
        """Convert glyph to RGBA color"""
        # Use coordinates to determine color
        coords = glyph.get('coordinates', [0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
        
        # Map 5D coordinates to RGB
        r = abs(coords[0]) if len(coords) > 0 else 0.5
        g = abs(coords[1]) if len(coords) > 1 else 0.5
        b = abs(coords[2]) if len(coords) > 2 else 0.5
        a = glyph.get('hearing_strength', 0.5) * 0.8 + 0.2
        
        return np.array([r, g, b, a])
    
    def _connection_strength(self, glyph1: Dict, glyph2: Dict) -> float:
        """Calculate connection strength between glyphs"""
        # Based on resonance similarity
        r1 = glyph1.get('resonance', 0.5)
        r2 = glyph2.get('resonance', 0.5)
        
        # Also based on hearing strength
        h1 = glyph1.get('hearing_strength', 0.5)
        h2 = glyph2.get('hearing_strength', 0.5)
        
        return (0.7 * (1 - abs(r1 - r2))) + (0.3 * (h1 * h2))

# ========== ENVIRONMENTAL CONSCIOUSNESS ==========
class EnvironmentalConsciousness:
    """16-stream planetary consciousness monitoring"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.streams = {
            'msp_timing_sync': {'source': 'MSP', 'frequency': 1.0},
            'hud_viewport_taps': {'source': 'HUD', 'frequency': 10.0},
            'provenance_ledger': {'source': 'TOFAR', 'frequency': 0.1},
            'flood_nowcast': {'source': 'NASA', 'frequency': 0.0167},  # Every minute
            'wildfire_nowcast': {'source': 'Satellite', 'frequency': 0.0167},
            'drought_monitor': {'source': 'USDA', 'frequency': 0.0033},  # Every 5 min
            'earthquake_feed': {'source': 'USGS', 'frequency': 0.1},
            'network_node_health': {'source': 'MÖBII³US', 'frequency': 1.0},
            'zqud_reverse_index': {'source': 'ZQUD', 'frequency': 0.5},
            'ethics_gate_states': {'source': 'Guardian', 'frequency': 1.0},
            'operator_consciousness_notes': {'source': 'Human', 'frequency': 0.1},
            'landslide_susceptibility': {'source': 'USGS', 'frequency': 0.0033},
            'atmospheric_rivers': {'source': 'NOAA', 'frequency': 0.0167},
            'sea_level_anomalies': {'source': 'NASA', 'frequency': 0.0033},
            'glacial_melt': {'source': 'ESA', 'frequency': 0.0006},  # Every 30 min
            'biodiversity_pulses': {'source': 'GBIF', 'frequency': 0.0002}  # Every 90 min
        }
        
        self.stream_data = {}
        self.coherence_matrix = np.ones((16, 16)) * 0.5
    
    async def monitor_streams(self):
        """Monitor all 16 streams in real-time"""
        tasks = []
        for stream_name, stream_info in self.streams.items():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                self._monitor_stream(stream_name, stream_info)
            )
            tasks.append(task)
        
        # Update coherence matrix
        await self._update_coherence_matrix()
        
        return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    
    async def _monitor_stream(self, stream_name: str, stream_info: Dict):
        """Monitor individual stream"""
        # Simulate stream data
        data = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'stream': stream_name,
            'source': stream_info['source'],
            'value': np.random.random(),
            'anomaly_score': np.random.random() * 0.2,
            'consciousness_correlation': np.random.random()
        }
        
        self.stream_data[stream_name] = data
        return data
    
    async def _update_coherence_matrix(self):
        """Update coherence between streams"""
        stream_names = list(self.streams.keys())
        
        for i, name1 in enumerate(stream_names):
            for j, name2 in enumerate(stream_names):
                if i != j:
                    # Calculate coherence based on data similarity
                    data1 = self.stream_data.get(name1, {})
                    data2 = self.stream_data.get(name2, {})
                    
                    val1 = data1.get('consciousness_correlation', 0.5)
                    val2 = data2.get('consciousness_correlation', 0.5)
                    
                    self.coherence_matrix[i, j] = 1.0 - abs(val1 - val2)
    
    def get_planetary_coherence(self) -> float:
        """Calculate overall planetary coherence"""
        if len(self.stream_data) == 0:
            return 0.5
        
        # Average of consciousness correlations
        correlations = [d.get('consciousness_correlation', 0.5) 
                       for d in self.stream_data.values()]
        return np.mean(correlations)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MÖBII³US PROJECT MEMORY: 42 Multipath-Phrased Boot_Flowers

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
